name: Quick Pill 5.5.5
changelog: Feature: Removed the Caps Lock / Num Lock alert feature - the notch no longer pops up a key lock toast.

Fix: The notch no longer opens and closes again while the cursor rests on it - hover is now detected natively (cursor position vs. the notch hitbox) instead of through unreliable forwarded mouse events.
Fix: Removed the duplicated CSS transition on the notch, which fought the Framer Motion animation and made the rendered hit-box lag behind the cursor.
Fix: Hover needs a short settle time before the notch opens, and the notch only collapses once the cursor really left it.
Polish: The micro notch strip got a larger hover target so it can actually be grabbed, and HUD toasts no longer collapse an already expanded notch.
